title: SOPHIA agent proposal
description: A small list of block-level changes an agent proposes for ONE SOPHIA document. A person loads it with Commands › Apply agent proposal…, previews every operation, keeps or rejects each one and applies them in one undo step. Get block IDs and texts from Commands › Export document map (.json). Embedded in every SOPHIA file as #sophia-proposal-schema; examples in the repository under sophia/agent-kit.

documentId.description: Exactly the documentId of the document map. A proposal for another document is refused.

baseDocumentVersion.description: documentVersion of the document map you worked from (e.g. "1.02"). A different current version only shows a warning.

author.description: Who wrote the proposal, e.g. "SOPHIA agent (Copilot)".

intent.description: One sentence: what the proposal achieves.

oneOf.title: replaceBlock — replace one block; the first new element keeps the block ID

expectedText.description: The block's current text (whitespace-normalised) from the document map. If it no longer matches, the operation is refused.

oneOf.title: insertAfter — insert new block(s) after a block
updateMeta — change an identity-table field by its label

field.description: The label text in the identity table. Document Version and the trace row are written by the editor.

oneOf.title: setBaseVersion — only for a document that was NEVER published, and only with a version the person gave you

blockId.description: data-block-id from the document map. Never invent one.

blockHtml.description: Document-grammar HTML only (agent brief §3): p, h2–h4 (no typed numbers), ul/ol > li, table > tbody > tr > th/td, aside.warning (first child Warning: or Confirmation required:), blockquote, hr, p.source-note, div.cards > section(.pending) > h3 + p/ul (Quick Card), inline b i u s sup sub br a[href^=https://] span.tbc and a.xref[data-xref]. No style, script, iframe, on* attributes, images or base64. New blocks have NO data-block-id (the editor assigns one).
